title: Assistant Manager - Compliance & Sustainability
description:
Job Description Lubi Electronics is looking for an experienced Compliance & Sustainability Manager to manage and strengthen our ISO, ESG, EHS, global customer, supplier and product compliance framework. The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in manufacturing / electronics / electrical / industrial automation / engineering industries , with exposure to multinational customers and compliance audits. 
 Key Responsibilities Manage ISO 9001, ISO 14001 & ISO 45001 systems. Lead internal, certification, customer, supplier, ESG and safety audits. Manage CAPA, RCA, non-conformities and corrective actions . Ensure compliance with applicable Indian safety and regulatory requirements . Develop and monitor ESG & sustainability initiatives . Handle customer compliance requirements, questionnaires and factory audits. Manage supplier qualification, vendor compliance and responsible sourcing. Coordinate product regulatory compliance including CE, UL, RoHS, REACH, WEEE, CMRT and SCIP . Maintain Declaration of Conformity and technical compliance documentation. Manage corporate compliance policies including Code of Conduct, Anti-Bribery & Anti-Corruption, Whistleblower and Supplier Code of Conduct . Coordinate customer information security questionnaires and support ISO 27001 requirements , where applicable. Prepare compliance reports, audit dashboards and management review documentation. Conduct compliance, safety and awareness training. Monitor regulatory changes and drive continuous improvement.

 Preferred Industry Electronics | Electrical | Industrial Automation | Control Panels | Renewable Energy | Industrial Networking | Engineering | EPC | Export Manufacturing 
 Qualification Bachelors Degree in Engineering / Environmental Engineering / Safety Engineering / Industrial Engineering or a related field. Preferred: ISO Lead Auditor | NEBOSH | IOSH | ESG/Sustainability Certification

Assistant Manager/ Manager Accounts & Compliance
description:
Position Overview 
The Accounts & Compliance Asst. Manager/ Manager is responsible for managing the organization s financial accounting, statutory compliance, and regulatory reporting functions. The role ensures adherence to accounting standards, company policies, and applicable laws, while maintaining accuracy and transparency in all financial records.

 Key Responsibilities 
 A. Accounting & Financial Management Oversee day-to-day accounting operations , including general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, and bank reconciliations. Ensure timely preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements . Monitor cash flow, working capital, and expense control. Coordinate with auditors for internal and statutory audits , ensuring timely closure of audit queries. Maintain accurate records in compliance with Ind AS / GAAP . Supervise invoice processing, vendor payments, and reconciliation of accounts. Implement and maintain accounting controls and SOPs. B. Compliance & Regulatory Management Ensure compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax, PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, and ROC filings. File monthly, quarterly, and annual returns accurately and within deadlines. Liaise with statutory authorities (GST, ROC, IT, etc.) and handle queries or inspections. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of statutory and regulatory changes and their business impact. Coordinate with consultants for secretarial compliance (Companies Act) and FEMA / RBI regulations where applicable. C. Payroll & Employee Compliance Verify and process monthly payroll accounting and statutory deductions. Ensure accurate PF, ESIC, and TDS compliance for employees. Prepare and issue Form 16 and annual compliance certificates . D. Reporting & Coordination Prepare MIS reports for management on key financial and compliance metrics. Support management in budgeting, variance analysis, and financial forecasting . Coordinate with external auditors, consultants, and internal stakeholders for smooth operations.
